_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `productName` is the SITE_NAME seam in apps/web/app/site.ts (the upstream template's own heading, `Blog.`); `domain` and `subdomain` are placeholders, because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in the source links the docs carry. The upstream template's directory (`examples/cms-sanity` in Vercel's next.js repository) shares the slug and is protected from the rename.
